questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Safety when you are out

welcome_page.title: Safety when you are out
welcome_page.description:
How safe you feel from crime, harassment and traffic in the area where you move around most. It takes about 2 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

questionnaire.title: Safety when you are out

sections.title: Personal security
sections.description: Think about the area where you move around most, on foot or by other means.

questions.text: During the day, how safe do you feel from theft or assault in this area?
After dark, how safe do you feel from theft or assault in this area?
How often are you harassed when you are out (e.g. insults, comments, unwanted attention)?
What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3)

options.text: People behaving in a threatening way
Corners or places where you can't see well

sections.title: Road safety
sections.description: Think about traffic in the same area.

questions.text: How safe from traffic accidents do you feel in this area?
Which situations make you feel unsafe in traffic? (Up to 3)

options.text: Missing pavements, crossings or cycle lanes
Places where you can't see or be seen well
Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders or pedestrians
Too many people or vehicles in the same space

questions.text: In the last 2 years, has any of these happened to you? (Select all that apply)

options.text: I was hit by a vehicle while walking
I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. on a broken pavement)
I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter
I had a crash in a car or on a motorcycle

it.#SmartUrbanity - Safety when you are out: SmartUrbanity - Sicurezza quando sei in giro
it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Alcune domande veloci per inquadrare le tue risposte.
it.#<p>Think about the area where you move: Pensa alla zona in cui ti muovi di più, a piedi o con altri mezzi.
it.#During the day, how safe do you feel fr: Di giorno, quanto ti senti al sicuro da furti o aggressioni in questa zona?
it.#After dark, how safe do you feel from t: Dopo il tramonto, quanto ti senti al sicuro da furti o aggressioni in questa zona?
it.#How often are you harassed when you are: Quanto spesso subisci molestie quando sei in giro (ad es. insulti, commenti, attenzioni indesiderate)?
it.#What makes you feel less safe? (Up to 3: Cosa ti fa sentire meno al sicuro? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Corners or places where you can't see w: Angoli o punti dove non si vede bene
it.#How safe from traffic accidents do you: Quanto ti senti al sicuro dagli incidenti stradali in questa zona?
it.#Which situations make you feel unsafe i: Quali situazioni ti fanno sentire in pericolo nel traffico? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Missing pavements, crossings or cycle l: Marciapiedi, attraversamenti o piste ciclabili mancanti
it.#Places where you can't see or be seen w: Punti dove non vedi o non sei visto/a bene
it.#Reckless behaviour of drivers, riders o: Comportamenti imprudenti di automobilisti, motociclisti, ciclisti o pedoni
it.#Too many people or vehicles in the same: Troppe persone o veicoli nello stesso spazio
it.#In the last 2 years, has any of these h: Negli ultimi 2 anni, ti è capitato qualcuno di questi episodi? (Puoi sceglierne più di uno)
it.#I tripped or fell while walking (e.g. o: Sono inciampato/a o caduto/a mentre camminavo (ad es. su un marciapiede rotto)
it.#I had a crash on a bike or e-scooter: Ho avuto un incidente in bici o in monopattino
it.#I had a crash in a car or on a motorcyc: Ho avuto un incidente in auto o in moto
it.#<p>How safe you feel from crime, harass:
Quanto ti senti al sicuro da furti, molestie e traffico nella zona in cui ti muovi di più. Richiede circa 2 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
